player_prompt.intro:
A yi walla Blackjack nda dealer.
Toluwa maa yi ko ɓuri 21 haa e ɓaawo.
Caggal ma, lakki '[Hit]' ngam haɗa kaari ujun, walla '[Stand]' ngam ɓaawo.
J/Q/K = 10 alama; A = 11 walla 1, koo ɓuri ɗum.
